title: Personalization / rep style

questions.text: Is the output consistent with the rep’s actual communication style without changing strategic content?

inputs: the rep profile (how this rep writes)

criteria.guide: Compare the draft's length and density against the rep's usual messages. Report direction (below / matches / above the rep's profile) and magnitude (none / slight / large) with a concrete phrase from the draft; never a numeric personality score.
criteria.before: Hi <name>, I hope you are well and that the week is treating you kindly. Following up on our conversation, I wanted to share a few thoughts and also attach the two documents you asked for, which I think you will find useful...
criteria.after: Hi <name>, the two documents you asked for are attached. Best, <rep>

criteria.guide: Compare the draft's register (greeting, sign-off, vocabulary) against the rep's own. Report direction (below / matches / above the rep's profile) and magnitude (none / slight / large) with a concrete phrase from the draft; never a numeric personality score.
criteria.before: Dear Sir or Madam, please find enclosed herewith the requested documentation for your kind perusal.
criteria.after: Hi <name>, here are the documents you asked for.

criteria.guide: Compare how plainly the draft states its ask or point against how plainly the rep usually does. Report direction (below / matches / above the rep's profile) and magnitude (none / slight / large) with a concrete phrase from the draft; never a numeric personality score.
criteria.before: I was wondering whether it might perhaps be possible, if convenient, to maybe find a moment at some point?
criteria.after: Could you share a 30-minute slot next week?

criteria.guide: Compare the draft's personal tone against the rep's usual tone. Report direction (below / matches / above the rep's profile) and magnitude (none / slight / large) with a concrete phrase from the draft; never a numeric personality score.
criteria.after: Thanks for pulling this together so quickly - the documents are attached.

criteria.guide: Compare the draft's urgency of wording against the rep's usual pressure. Report direction (below / matches / above the rep's profile) and magnitude (none / slight / large) with a concrete phrase from the draft; never a numeric personality score.
criteria.before: We need your signature by Friday at the latest or we lose the slot.
criteria.after: Whenever your review is done, I'm happy to walk through any questions.

principles: Keep style separate from strategic company knowledge.
Strategic learning and style learning are not the same: judge HOW it is said, never who is addressed, what is asked or when (§24).
Use direction/magnitude and concrete before/after examples rather than fake personality scores.
